انتهكا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَهَكَا (intahakā) /in.ta.ha.kaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# اُنْتُهِكَا (untuhikā) /un.tu.hi.kaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# اِنْتَهِكَا (intahikā) /in.ta.hi.kaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
